question: ______ the Managing Editor of Mongabay India, received the 2024 Greenaccord International Media Award at a ceremony in Frascati, Italy on October 12, 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**S Gopikrishna Warrier**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2024 Greenaccord International Media Award was presented to Mongabay India and the China Biodiversity Conservation and Green Development Foundation (CBCGDF) Media. This prestigious award, given annually by the Italy-based non-profit Greenaccord, recognizes news organizations that demonstrate exceptional commitment to environmental journalism and raising awareness about critical ecological issues.
 
• Here's a detailed look at the 2024 Greenaccord International Media Award:
 
• **Award Recipients:**
 
 
• Mongabay India: The India-specific bureau of Mongabay, a renowned global environmental news platform, was recognized for its in-depth and impactful reporting on India's biodiversity, climate change impacts, renewable energy transition, and other environmental topics.
 
• China Biodiversity Conservation and Green Development Foundation (CBCGDF) Media: This Chinese media outlet was also honored for its contributions to environmental journalism and its efforts to promote ecological awareness in China.
 
• Award Ceremony: The awards were presented on October 12th, 2024, at the Greenaccord International Forum for Information on Safeguarding Nature held in Frascati, Italy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Significance of the Award:**
 
• Recognition of Excellence: The Greenaccord International Media Award is a significant recognition of journalistic excellence in the field of environmental reporting. It highlights the crucial role that media plays in informing the public and driving positive change for the environment.
 
• Global Platform: The award provides a global platform for environmental journalists to showcase their work and connect with other professionals in the field.
 
• Promotion of Sustainability: By recognizing outstanding environmental journalism, the award encourages media organizations to prioritize environmental coverage and contribute to a more sustainable future.
 
• **Mongabay India's Contribution:**
 
 
• In-depth Reporting: Mongabay India has consistently produced high-quality, deeply reported stories on a wide range of environmental issues in India.
 
• Impactful Journalism: Their reporting has had a significant impact, raising awareness about critical environmental challenges and influencing policy decisions.
 
• Multilingual Reach: Mongabay India publishes in both English and Hindi, ensuring that their content reaches a wider audience.
 
• Greenaccord's Mission: Greenaccord is an Italian non-profit organization that promotes environmental awareness and sustainable development. The Greenaccord International Media Award is one of its key initiatives to recognize and support environmental journalism.
 
• Selection Process: The award winners are selected by a jury of experts who evaluate the quality, originality, and impact of the news organizations' environmental reporting.
